stem:
Cara and Marcus shared a candy bar. The models are shaded to show the fraction of the candy bar each of them ate.

Cara  [8 shaded out of 11 total]
Marcus  [3 shaded out of 11 total]

What fraction of the candy bar did Cara and Marcus eat altogether?
visual_elements: Two rectangular bar models: Cara's model has 11 total parts with 8 shaded, Marcus's model has 11 total parts with 3 shaded.
